verdict.probe_answer: Diagnosis is correct and complete, including the separate rustfmt issue, but no code fix was applied.
verdict.rationale: The report explicitly identifies the non-glob workspace member drop mechanism: after 04c6b0b, workspace_members is populated only from successfully parsed package manifests, so a declared literal member with a malformed Cargo.toml is omitted. It also separately identifies the cargo fmt failure as an unformatted long assert in the same commit. The arm did not change code and labels the fix as recommended/not applied, so fix_attempted is false. Although the proposed fix shape matches the landed union approach, fix_shape_match is false under the rubric because no fix was attempted.
